name: Combined Volume and Surface Rendering with Global Illumination Caching
aliases: Combined volume and surface rendering with global illumination caching
definition: A combined volume and surface rendering technique that uses volumetric path tracing to compute the global illumination volume and local shading models for rendering the isosurface, joined to enhance surface display while preserving physically realistic illumination of participating media.
summary: This method combines volume and surface rendering to display isosurfaces in participating media with realistic illumination, distinguished by using volumetric path tracing and optional global illumination caching for camera-view-independent performance.
